questions.q: According to Ramsey, where does a company's culture come from?
a: The qualities of its leader
The size of its marketing budget
The loyalty of its oldest customers
The structure of its pay grades
questions.why: Lesson 1 says a company's culture is born of its leader's qualities.

questions.q: How did Ramsey's first Life After Debt class turn out?
a: Only six people showed up
It sold out within a week
It was cancelled for lack of advertising
It drew hundreds of attendees
questions.why: Lesson 2 describes a meager six people attending the free first session.

questions.q: Why did Ramsey rename the class Financial Peace University?
a: He realized people wanted financial security, not debt help
He wanted to charge a much higher price
A competitor had claimed the old name
The radio station asked him to rebrand
questions.why: Lesson 2 says his class was not solving the problem his audience cared about.

questions.q: What happens when a leader pays employees generously, per the summary?
a: They work harder and stay loyal
They expect fewer responsibilities
They become slower to innovate
They ask for more time off
questions.why: Lesson 3 says good compensation breeds hard work and loyalty.

questions.q: What happened to the company that limited pay while earning over 50 million dollars?
a: Employees left for better pay and it shut down
It doubled revenue within a year
It was bought by a larger competitor
It replaced staff with contractors
questions.why: Lesson 3 says enough people quit that the business had to close.
